name: avalynx-toast
title: AvalynxToast
description: AvalynxToast is a simple toast system for web applications. Based on Bootstrap >=5.3 without any framework dependencies.

author.name: Juergen Schwind an the AvalynxToast Authors

scripts.build: shx rm -rf dist; shx mkdir -p dist/js/; shx cp src/js/avalynx-toast.js dist/js/avalynx-toast.js; shx cp src/js/avalynx-toast.js dist/js/avalynx-toast.esm.js; node build.js dist/js/avalynx-toast.esm.js; shx mkdir -p dist/css/; shx cp src/css/avalynx-toast.css dist/css/avalynx-toast.css
